project_context.theme: Light theme with dark accents (High-Contrast Swiss & Professional)

primary_font.weight: font-black for H1/H2, font-semibold for KPI numbers

secondary_font.usage: Body text, UI labels, table headers, descriptions

mono_font.usage: ADM Codes, Prices, Vending Coordinates (A01..M12), Stock counts

contrast_rules.text: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Never use pure #000000 or #808080.
contrast_rules.interactive: Always explicitly set hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
contrast_rules.accents: Use Signal Red (#DC2626) exclusively for 'ESAURITO', 'RIORDINO', and negative inventory.

spacing_and_layout.base_padding: Generous container padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision, but tight internal widget spacing.
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed on desktop, hidden on mobile with hamburger. Dark themed (bg-slate-900 text-white) to provide the requested 'dark accent'.
spacing_and_layout.topbar: h-16 sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white border-b border-slate-200. NEVER transparent.

grids.dashboard_kpis: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
grids.vending_matrix: grid grid-cols-[repeat(13,minmax(0,1fr))] gap-2 (Columns A to M). Use dense square cells.
grids.tables: w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap. Use sticky headers.

cards.style: Flat background (bg-white), 1px solid border-border, no shadow by default.
cards.hover: Hover state: -translate-y-[2px] transition-transform duration-200, shadow-md, border-slate-300.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors

status_badges.ok: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase
status_badges.warning: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase
status_badges.error: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold uppercase

vending_cell.style: aspect-square flex flex-col items-center justify-center border rounded-md relative overflow-hidden

motion.hover_states: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out on all interactive elements.
motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (framer-motion: initial={opacity: 0, y: 10} animate={opacity: 1, y: 0}).
motion.staggered_lists: Stagger table row entrances by 0.05s for a refined feeling.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG 2 adherence. No transparent backgrounds behind text unless heavily blurred.
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

icons.style: duotone or regular weight. Use precise, technical icons.

instructions_to_main_agent.overview: You are building a high-density, professional ERP/management dashboard for an Italian Tobacco Shop. The layout must feel like enterprise software (think Bloomberg Terminal or high-end fintech), not a generic consumer app.
key_areas: Dashboard KPIs: Must clearly show purchased vs sold value, stock value, items to reorder, negative stock.
Vending Machine Grid: Create a specialized visual representation of columns A01 to M12, color-coded by stock level.
Tables: Use dense, functional Shadcn UI tables. Monospace fonts for numbers/prices/ADM codes.
Forms: Daily sales input and parameters configuration must use Shadcn forms with tight spacing.
instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: Override standard fonts in tailwind.config.js to use Chivo for sans and IBM Plex Sans/Mono for body/data.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn_customization: Remove heavy drop shadows from Shadcn cards. Use 1px borders. Force square or slightly rounded (rounded-md max 6px) corners.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Align content to the left for better readability in data-heavy apps.
Never apply `transition: all`. Use specific transitions (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
Use 2-3x more spacing between major layout sections (e.g., gap-8 between KPI grid and main table), but keep internal component spacing dense.
Do not use AI assistant emojis (🤖, 💡, etc). Use standard @phosphor-icons/react icons.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='btn-reorder'`).
Ensure dark accents are used purposefully (e.g., the primary sidebar or top header can be dark Slate-900, while the rest is light #F8F9FA).
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns. Use Solid White or Slate-900.
Always use the Sonner library for toast notifications.
